notes.title: Just A Shadow Game Joins Neon Doctrine in The Carnival of Chaos!
notes.content:
Mortals! Gather round, for we have completed a ritual of unprecedented power! 

Through arcane negotiations, [b]we have forged a blood-bound contract with the nefarious [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/nd]Neon Doctrine[/url] to publish our masterpiece, Just A Shadow Game[/b]! With this cursed contract we are one step closer in our grand plan and another piece is added to our our ritual of conquest!

[previewyoutube=1tAJxl6AhR4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are excited to welcome other twisted souls to join our cause and what better place to do so than the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32940668/sale/carnivalofchaos]Neon Doctrine Carnival of Chaos[/url]? A demonstration (or "Demo", if you will) will be available for your perusal and wishlisting is encouraged!

[b]Presenting a chilling, thrilling, killer collection of ghoulish games and devilish demos, featuring the demo of Just A Shadow Game![/b]

[i]Hoard dark magics and build a deck of corrupted buildings, abominations, and dark secrets. [/i]

[h3][b]Join the Shadow's eternal game by playing the demo NOW:[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456690/Just_A_Shadow_Game_Demo/ 

[b]What's New in the Demo[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 new cards
[*] 2 new buildings
[*] Simplified Chinese added
[*] Updated game text
[/list]
